gaps.sentence: He's getting his eyes ___ next week.
gaps.explanation: Causative get + object + past participle: getting his eyes tested (by an optician).

gaps.sentence: A new ring road ___ (construct) around the city at present.
gaps.explanation: 'At present' requires present continuous passive: is being + constructed.

gaps.sentence: Endangered plants ___ (not pick) anywhere in the reserve.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive of prohibition: must not be + past participle.

gaps.sentence: The debt ___ (repay) in full by May, he promised.
gaps.explanation: Reported future passive: would be + past participle after a past reporting verb.
'By + future time' signals future perfect passive: will have been + processed.

gaps.sentence: This form ___ (sign) in ink — digital signatures aren't valid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: modal + be + past participle. Obligation: must (also has to) be signed.

gaps.sentence: You should get that rash ___ (look at) by a doctor.
gaps.explanation: Causative 'get something done': get + object + past participle (looked at).

gaps.sentence: Nothing ___ about the incident until the inquiry began.
gaps.explanation: Nothing was known by anybody: past simple passive was + known.
